title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: The lifecycle rules, licensing, admin paths and beta block call are supported by Microsoft's documentation. Minor corrections should acknowledge the registry page's different inventory-filter labels and cite the page that documents Pin for users.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; controls[0].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can create a rule to block ownerless agents without usage.
claims.quote: Admins can create a custom rule to block multiple ownerless agents that have no usage.

claims.claim: Applying a template is a supported rule-based bulk action.
claims.quote: Use the Apply template action in an agent management rule to apply security policies to existing agents.

claims.claim: A rule can reject agent publish requests older than a specified number of days.
claims.quote: Admins can create a custom rule to reject multiple agent publish requests that are older than a specified number of days.

claims.claim: The Agent settings page does not document a rule for automatically deleting inactive agents.
claims.quote: Searched: agent management rules risky inactive delete notifications scope publisher tag environment. Opened Agent settings in full and Agent 365 overview; settings lists five actions and no deletion rule. Entra lifecycle policies concern a different control.

claims.claim: The Agent 365 overview describes rules-based management that can block risky agents.
claims.quote: Automate ongoing agent governance - Leverage rules-based agent management to automatically enforce lifecycle policies, such as flagging ownerless agents, or blocking risky agents.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Agent settings does not specify a risky-agent rule condition or which risk signals a rule consumes.
claims.quote: Searched: agent management rules risky inactive delete notifications scope publisher tag environment. Read Agent settings in full; reviewed Agent 365 overview and registry risk-signal documentation. No rule-to-risk-signal mapping is stated.

claims.claim: Apply template is a one-time bulk operation rather than a scheduled rule.
claims.quote: The Apply template action is a one-time bulk operation. It isn't a scheduled rule.

claims.claim: Manual installation is available for eligible agents.
claims.quote: You can install agents across the whole organization or for specific users or groups by using the same controls that work for any other app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Manual blocking and unblocking are available.
claims.quote: Block or unblock agents for the entire organization by using the same controls that work for any other app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: An administrator can uninstall a previously installed agent.
claims.quote: Admin can uninstall a previously installed agent.

claims.claim: Agent details provides a Pin for users action.
claims.quote: Pin for users | The agent is pinned in the UI (based on channel) where the agent was deployed, so that the agent can be found more easily.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/agent-details to sources for the exact Pin for users action label.

claims.claim: Available manual actions depend on agent type and deployment or publisher state.
claims.quote: Available admin actions differ by agent type and publisher state. For example, some entries offer Delete, others offer Remove, and some offer only Block.

claims.claim: All agents has a Missing an owner inventory filter.

claims.claim: All agents has an Availability > No users inventory filter.

claims.claim: Only agents deployed to some or all users can be pinned.
claims.quote: You can only pin agents that are deployed to some or all users.

claims.claim: Blocking Agent Builder or Copilot Studio agents affects Copilot and other hosts such as Outlook and Teams.
claims.quote: Blocking or unblocking an agent that you created by using Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder and Microsoft Copilot Studio affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot. It also affects availability and functionality in other host products, such as Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams

claims.claim: Blocking SharePoint or Foundry agents affects only their availability in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: However, blocking an agent that you created by using SharePoint or Microsoft Foundry only impacts its availability in Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: Researcher availability can be blocked tenant-wide but cannot be scoped using Edit users.
claims.quote: For the Researcher and Analyst agents, the Edit users panel is disabled. To manage their availability, block the agent for the entire tenant by using the Block action in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Analyst availability can be blocked tenant-wide but cannot be scoped using Edit users.
claims.quote: For the Researcher and Analyst agents, the Edit users panel is disabled. To manage their availability, block the agent for the entire tenant by using the Block action in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Agents can become ownerless when their creator leaves the organisation.
claims.quote: Agents become ownerless when their original creator leaves the organization. Administrators must currently identify and transfer ownership manually, which can result in lifecycle governance gaps.

claims.quote:
Prerequisites for viewing risk signals

- Your tenant must have an E7 or A365 license.

claims.claim: Registry risk signals come from security platforms such as Purview, Entra and Defender.

claims.claim: Admin-center deletion soft-deletes an agent.
claims.quote: When you delete an agent in the Microsoft 365 admin center, the agent is soft deleted.

claims.claim: Soft-deleted agents have a 30-day recovery window.
claims.quote: During the 30-day retention period, you can restore the agent or permanently delete it.

claims.claim: Permanent deletion cannot be undone.
claims.quote: Permanently deleting an agent removes the agent and its associated resources and can't be undone.
